articles.title: President Trump's Grass Obsession: Why He Can't Stop Talking About Lawns
articles.summary: President Trump has talked about grass at least 45 times in 18 months—that's once every 12 days! From golf courses to the White House lawn, he says he's 'very good at grass.'

articles.title: Why More Grown-Up Kids Are Living With Their Parents—and Parents Are Helping Pay the Bills
articles.summary: Mabel Lago, 70-something, built a bigger retirement home so her 39-year-old son could live with her. A new survey says 75% of parents help their adult kids with money—about $7,000 a year on average!

articles.title: Did a Famous Professor Copy His Work? Cambridge University Is Investigating!
articles.summary: A top professor at Cambridge University quit after people said he copied others' work and made up parts of his life story. Now the school is checking how they hire big-name teachers.
